finding: Across all four reviewed fixed latents, resetting17 synthesis activation-bias offsets on top of common17 noise-offset reset gives the largest restoration of brightness, continuous facial shading and readable details. ToRGB bias reset partly reduces color cast; affine/mapping bias resets give no comparable visible improvement.
limitations: Conditional inference intervention at one source-layout checkpoint, not training outcome
Residual warm/red coloration and some detail defects
Source identities including apparent children/headwear/non-clergy retained
No attractiveness assessment or production-quality approval
decision: Fresh original-source output_rank1 stability run with17 noise and17 synthesis activation-bias offsets fixed at zero; leave mapping/style-affine/ToRGB biases trainable. Observe all four original latents early. Do not run prior noise-only variant unchanged after this evidence.
